description: ToolInvocation Audit Table and audit query module - comprehensive audit trail for every tool execution with scrubbed argument storage and query/filter capabilities.
steps: Create src/nexus/models/tool_invocation.py: ToolInvocation SQLModel table (id UUID PK, company_id FK, agent_id FK to agents, tool_id FK to tools, connection_id UUID nullable, tool_name str, arguments_scrubbed JSON, result_summary str nullable, status [success/error/timeout/denied/rate_limited], duration_ms int, cost_cents int default 0, approval_state [not_required/approved/denied] default not_required, error str nullable, created_at datetime, completed_at datetime nullable)
Update src/nexus/models/__init__.py to import and export ToolInvocation

Create src/nexus/tools/audit.py: ToolAuditStore class with in-memory list storage. Methods: record(invocation: ToolInvocation), query(agent_id=None, tool_id=None, status=None, since=None, limit=100) -> list[ToolInvocation], get_stats(agent_id=None, since=None) -> AuditStats dataclass (total_invocations, success_count, error_count, total_cost_cents, avg_duration_ms)

Enhance src/nexus/tools/executor.py: Add optional audit_store: ToolAuditStore parameter to ToolExecutor.__init__. After each execution in the execute() method, if audit_store is set, create a ToolInvocation record and call audit_store.record(). Scrub sensitive fields from arguments (keys containing 'password', 'secret', 'token', 'key' get replaced with '***').
Create tests/test_tool_audit.py: Test ToolInvocation model instantiation, ToolAuditStore record/query/stats, argument scrubbing in executor, integration test of executor -> audit_store recording flow
acceptance_criteria: ToolAuditStore correctly records and queries invocations with filters
ToolExecutor with audit_store records invocations on success, failure, timeout, and permission denial
Sensitive argument keys are scrubbed before storage
findings: Added tool_invocations to EXPECTED_TABLES in test_alembic_migration.py and updated count from 53 to 54. The ToolExecutor now has _scrub_arguments as a module-level function and _record_invocation as a method. Audit store recording is skipped if company_id is None.
